case.prompt: Test that the server uses my Composio key when I provide it and otherwise uses the hosted proxy seamlessly, while the desktop always uses the proxy.
case.setup: Real createDefaultAdapters, provider and SDK in separate scrubbed-environment subprocesses. Stateful synthetic transport; unrelated model initialization bypassed. No live provider, model or normal local database.
case.expected_result: Desktop always managed; server explicit key direct; server no key managed; trusted proxy override and stable isolated identity work; same-project direct key rotation retains existing owned connections.
case.holdout: Rotated explicit key, persisted/restarted profile, distinct owners and replaced tenant data root with stable secret.

DEFAULT.applies_when: The frozen scenario contains the subject named in the condition.
DEFAULT.pass_condition: Actual desktop composition ignores environment and saved Composio keys and custom proxy overrides; signed requests target the hosted proxy.
DEFAULT.evidence: Frozen harness trace, before/after database/profile, actual signed SDK requests and assertions.

EXPLICIT.evidence: Frozen harness trace, before/after database/profile, actual signed SDK requests and assertions.

KEYLESS.applies_when: The frozen scenario contains the subject named in the condition.
KEYLESS.pass_condition: Actual server composition without an environment key uses signed hosted requests without any project key.
KEYLESS.evidence: Frozen harness trace, before/after database/profile, actual signed SDK requests and assertions.

CUSTOM.applies_when: The frozen scenario contains the subject named in the condition.
CUSTOM.pass_condition: Non-desktop composition accepts a trusted custom proxy and signs requests for that exact origin.
CUSTOM.evidence: Frozen harness trace, before/after database/profile, actual signed SDK requests and assertions.

IDENTITY.applies_when: The frozen scenario contains the subject named in the condition.
IDENTITY.pass_condition: Restart preserves the managed identity; distinct local profiles/owners remain isolated; tenant identity survives data-root replacement with the same owner secret.
IDENTITY.evidence: Frozen harness trace, before/after database/profile, actual signed SDK requests and assertions.

PRESERVE.applies_when: The frozen scenario contains the subject named in the condition.
PRESERVE.pass_condition: Explicit direct same-project key rotation preserves the account, active state, local connection ID, watch preference, cursor and queued work without consent.
PRESERVE.evidence: Frozen harness trace, before/after database/profile, actual signed SDK requests and assertions.

NOLEGACY.applies_when: The frozen scenario contains the subject named in the condition.
NOLEGACY.pass_condition: No legacy provider, old-key fallback, UUID adoption or migration certificate is added.
NOLEGACY.evidence: Frozen harness trace, before/after database/profile, actual signed SDK requests and assertions.

SECRET.applies_when: The frozen scenario contains the subject named in the condition.
SECRET.pass_condition: Managed requests and renderer/sandbox settings contain no project key or private signing key.
SECRET.evidence: Frozen harness trace, before/after database/profile, actual signed SDK requests and assertions.
